title: jasminum annamense subsp. kerrii
intro: Jasminum annamense subsp. kerrii, commonly known as the Vietnamese jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. This plant is known for its fragrant and white flowers, which are often used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The health benefits of Vietnamese jasmine include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Vietnamese jasmine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties.
